fact.pat_definition: Total profit/loss for period, including equity-accounted associates/JVs where reported; not assumed to be owners-of-parent attributable PAT.
fact.notes: Exact reported quarter column; YTD/annual columns and other income are not used as quarterly sales. No forecast or quarterly growth rate inferred.

note: Primary financial-fact pilot. Accounting/date/unit review and source verification required before publication. Missing prior-year quarters, ROCE and valuation remain unavailable.
